notes.title: 02.02 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In this patch, we are happy to announce that the game has oficially gained 2 new idioms:

- French (Translation by François Tomaszewski—Trouvain )
- Russian (Translation by Egor Meshcheryakov)

Game updates:

- Fixed several bugs where the player could get stuck
- Adjusted several levels in the First stage of the game to pffer a more adequate difficulty
